headline: Executive order updates the list of officials who would run the EPA if its top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order changes an earlier order, Executive Order 13261, which set the order of succession at the Environmental Protection Agency. That list says which officials would temporarily act as EPA Administrator if the Administrator and Deputy Administrator die, resign, or cannot do the job. The title does not say exactly which positions were added, removed, or moved.

who_it_affects.how: It changes which officials would step in, and in what order, to lead the agency temporarily if the top posts are empty.
